text:
natalie: Hey everyone — rolling out a small release and a community event combo. We just published redwood-starters v0.1.0: a collection of tiny opinionated starter apps (Next.js + Redwood inference quick wiring, example infra + CI). Release notes + install steps below. Also hosting a community Hack Night + live demo this Wed 5pm PT. Maintainers: please skim the CONTRIBUTING.md in the repo before the call.

release-bot: New release published: redwood-inference/redwood-starters v0.1.0 
https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-starters/releases/tag/v0.1.0
Changelog: initial templates, CI, GH Actions deploy, small CLI helper.

natalie: Quick install snippet for the smallest starter: 
```bash
npx create-redwood-starter my-app --template minimal-inference
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev
```

ishaan: License? MIT? want to mirror main org policy.

natalie: Yes MIT. Added a LICENSE file and a short note about attribution in CONTRIBUTING.md.

marcus: Nice. Are we planning to backport the helper CLI to the redwoodctl plugin? some users asked about local mock runtime.

sophia: I can take the redwoodctl adapter as a follow-up PR next week. happy to pair with whoever wants it.

natalie: thanks @sophia — that would be perfect. linking the starter repo here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-starters

devrel-bot: RSVP form for the Hack Night / AMA: https://forms.gle/example-hacknight (fill if you want to demo something or need help onboarding)

tara: :partyparrot: nice! putting it on the community calendar.

ishaan: Any security concerns for the templates? secrets in CI?

natalie: No real secrets — templates use placeholder env vars and recommend KMS for prod. There's a security checklist in SECURITY.md. Maintainers should review the checklist; will call it out in the Hack Night.

release-bot: Patch notes snippet:
- feat: add minimal-inference starter with example prompt pipeline
- ci: GH Actions to build + lint + deploy to vercel (demo app)
- docs: CONTRIBUTING + SECURITY + quickstart

marcus: Cool. Can we get a short changelog blurb I can paste into the community newsletter? two lines max.

natalie: "redwood-starters v0.1 — tiny opinionated templates to get inference-powered apps up and running. Join our Hack Night Wed 5pm PT for demo + Q&A."

sophia: I'll host the demo. who wants to co-present the CLI piece?

marcus: I'll do the CLI bit.

natalie: Great — thanks! If anyone else is volunteering for lightning talks, add yourself to the RSVP form. See you Wednesday. :thumbsup:
